properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms have changed little in organization since  this morning in association with an area of low pressure located  several hundred miles southwest of the Azores. However, just a small  increase in organization is likely to result in the formation of a  tropical depression as soon as later today. The system is expected  to move slowly over the next couple of days remaining southwest of  the Azores, followed by a turn to the southwest by early next week,  when environmental conditions are forecast to become less favorable  for additional development.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...70 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...70 percent.

A broad area of low pressure located about 800 miles  south-southwest of the southwestern coast of Mexico continues to  produce disorganized shower and thunderstorm activity.  Environmental conditions are conducive for development, and a  tropical depression is likely to form late this weekend or early  next week while it moves generally northward off the coast of  southwestern Mexico. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...40 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

Showers and thunderstorms associated with an area of low pressure  located almost 1000 miles south-southwest of the southern tip of  the Baja California Peninsula have become a little better organized  since yesterday, but the system's circulation remains broad and  elongated. Environmental conditions appear conducive for additional  development of this system, and a tropical depression is likely to  form this weekend as it moves westward at 10 to 15 mph across the  western East Pacific. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...70 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

properties.nhcTitle: Well East-Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands (Former TD 15-E)
properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms associated with the remnants of Tropical  Depression Fifteen-E, located more than 1000 miles east-southeast  of the Hawaiian Islands, remain disorganized. Environmental  conditions appear conducive for some development of this system  next week as it moves westward to west-southwestward, and a  tropical depression could form well to the south or southeast of the  Hawaiian Islands by the middle to latter part of next week. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...10 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...medium...40 percent.
